A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work, with readable text, equations, figures, tables, and substantive appendices. Relocated material can be matched reliably. v2's final Appendix G contains only a heading, not additional technical content.

before.justification: v2 reports original view-synthesis experiments, ablations, rendering comparisons, and tomography results, including Tables 1–3 and appendix results.

after.justification: v3 retains original view-synthesis and tomography results and adds author-run Zip-NeRF evaluations, a NeRF-Synthetic comparison, and quantitative failure analysis.

M1.justification: The analytic Gaussian transmittance computation, alpha blending, density reparameterization, and core densification steps remain unchanged. The newly specified spherical-harmonic softplus activation is implementation disclosure; the PDFs do not establish that it represents an algorithm change.

E1.justification: v3 Appendix C adds evaluation on all eight NeRF-Synthetic scenes, extending coverage to synthetic object-centric multiview reconstruction beyond v2's single-image toy examples. The existing real-world view-synthesis datasets and synthetic/real tomography coverage are retained.

E2.justification: Table 1 adds Zip-NeRF on all three view-synthesis datasets. EVER gains reported comparisons on Tanks&Temples and DeepBlending, where v2 had dashes. The other baseline sets, including the relocated ablation and tomography comparisons, are retained.

E3.justification: v3 adds matched-initialization/no-densification controls for NeRF-Synthetic, failure thresholds of 1 dB PSNR, 0.01 SSIM and 0.005 LPIPS, and Zip-NeRF resolution/COLMAP procedures. v2's percent_dense settings of 0.02/0.05/0.015 are replaced in the documentation by scene-extent multipliers of 2/5/1.5. This is a reported settings revision; rerunning existing experiments is not established.

E4.justification: Appendix C adds a controlled multiview test intended to isolate representational expressiveness from densification dynamics. Appendix I, Figure 10 and Table 7 add systematic per-image failure analysis and Kitchen/Treehill case studies. The existing Flowers ablations, memory-budget study and ray-marching comparison are retained, not newly introduced.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests or comparable uncertainty estimates. v3's failure percentages and worst-case gaps describe test-image outcomes rather than introducing uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: v3 adds Zip-NeRF and previously missing EVER scores, NeRF-Synthetic results, failure statistics and tomography-slice PSNRs. The new controlled NeRF-Synthetic test reports 29.81/0.941/0.074 versus 3DGS's 29.56/0.936/0.082 for PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS. Garden's entries change from 26.87/0.8395/0.1603 to 27.29/0.858/0.122 without explaining the revision. The main aggregate results for the proposed method and the tomography table remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Appendix B, Eq. (30), corrects the factor in the definition of K from (mu_j - o^T) to (mu_j - o)^T, repairing a malformed quadratic-form expression. The remaining derivation and the sorting/non-overlap assumptions are retained.

C1.justification: Both versions claim analytically integrated Gaussian transmittance within rasterization, improved representation of opaque surfaces and perceptual view-synthesis quality, and direct applicability to tomography. The abstract's revised wording about splatting approximations does not materially change these contributions.

C2.justification: Section 3.2 now clarifies that exponential-transmittance linearization is not strictly necessary for splatting. The failure discussion expands beyond v2's calibration example: Figure 10 attributes a Kitchen failure to a floater and identifies insufficient densification and possible pose errors for Treehill. Section 6.1 also adds the Zip-NeRF quality/speed tradeoff.

D1.justification: v2 promises code release after publication; v3 reports public availability and provides a repository link. Appendix D newly specifies softplus activation with beta=10 for spherical-harmonic coefficients and revises densification-setting documentation. Appendix F adds Zip-NeRF hardware, resolution, COLMAP and training-time information. Existing timings for the proposed method and 3DGS are relocated.

R1.justification: v3 adds the Zip-NeRF paper and CamP/Zip-NeRF code-release references and discusses Zip-NeRF's relationship to the method. The broader positioning against rasterization, point-based ray tracing and tomography work remains stable; duplicate references and bibliographic updates do not establish additional research coverage.

P1.justification: The abstract, background and other passages receive local wording and terminology edits. Section 6.1 is condensed by moving detailed runtimes, memory-budget discussion and ablations into Appendices F–H, and the appendices are reorganized. The overall argument and most method exposition remain intact.

P2.justification: v3 adds Figures 8 and 10 and the three-part Table 7. Tomography images move from appendix Figure 8 to main-text Figure 5; the memory-budget plot and ablation table move into the appendices. Table 1 adds a row and restricts ranking colors to point-based methods. Figure 4 is resized and recompressed at substantially lower image resolution, reducing zoom fidelity.

improvement.justification: v3 adds controlled multiview validation, fuller comparator evidence, quantified failure cases and reported public code access to v2's existing benchmark results and ablations. These improve support and transparency around the unchanged central contribution. Reduced Figure 4 image fidelity and unexplained revisions to Garden scores and densification settings temper the overall gain.
